SMTO-OBS-0003 — This run was already started

GUID: 36fdf0ca-04fa-442a-80e9-0675c4ff2013
Slug: trace-preparation-reused
Domain: OBS · Subsystem: obs

What happened

  • SMTO was asked to start a prepared run that had already been started once, so it refused to start it again. This keeps the same work from running twice.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the conversation, or the Workflows or Schedules page if this came from a workflow or schedule, and look for this Task's run. The first start may have gone through, so the work may already be under way.
  2. If the run is there, let it finish instead of starting it again. A second start would repeat whatever the first run does.
  3. Only if there's no sign the work ran, start the Task or workflow again. A fresh start creates a new run, which SMTO accepts.

What success looks like

  • One run for this Task appears in the conversation, or on the Workflows or Schedules page, and it makes progress.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep starting the same Task; each extra start could repeat its work.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • AgentTraceStore.claim_prepared_request refused to claim a prepared trace whose status is no longer pending or whose submitted_at is already set, so the submission was rejected with 409.

What this means

  • Prepared-request claiming finds a trace whose state is no longer pending or whose submitted_at is already set. Observation is read-only and scoped to retained evidence. Missing, ambiguous or incomplete presentation cannot prove that external work failed or never happened; no diagnostic reconstructs or replays it.

Why this can happen

  • Prepared-request claiming finds a trace whose state is no longer pending or whose submitted_at is already set.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the original trace/task before creating a new identity for any remaining work.

How to fix it

  • Inspect the prior trace for this request_id and its native run receipts to see whether the first submission already started. Submit remaining work only with a new request identity; never resubmit a stale prepared_request_id.
  • Refresh the current task and submit with a new request identity only for work that remains. Inspect the prior trace to avoid duplicate execution.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • Only a current unclaimed prepared identity is submitted, with prior effects preserved.

What not to do

  • Do not submit a stale identifier or revision after another actor changed the resource.

Technical notes

  • Observation is read-only and scoped to retained evidence. Missing, ambiguous or incomplete presentation cannot prove that external work failed or never happened; no diagnostic reconstructs or replays it.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
